scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 3 ning IKKINCHI varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Betda ikkita rasm va ikkita bo'sh yozuv maydoni bor:

1) YUQORIDA — oq yog'och uy (ikki qavatli, uchburchak tomli, oq panjarali hovli, panjaraga suyab qo'yilgan velosiped). Ustida qizil oval yorliq: 'FOR RENT'. O'ng tomonda 14 ta nuqtali qator.

2) PASTDA — qizil g'ishtli ko'p qavatli bino (Britaniya/Boston uslubida, temir panjarali balkonlar, pechak o'simligi, qora eshik). Ustida 'FOR RENT' yorlig'i. Chap yuqorida sariq-qizil yulduzcha ichida: 'BARGAIN!'. Chap tomonda 16 ta nuqtali qator.

⚠ Har ikkala maydon ham BO'SH — kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN.

⚠ 'FOR RENT' va 'BARGAIN!' yorliqlaridan vazifa aniq: o'quvchi har uy uchun IJARA E'LONI yozadi.

⚠ Bu — Unit 3 ning IKKINCHI varag'i (Photo File 3-unit varag'i — Paulaning rasmli xati, bu bet — yozish varag'i). Shu sababli Unit 3 ga IKKI varaq ajratilgan.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 3: For Rent (write your own advertisements)
sections.titleUz: Rasmli kartalar - 3-unit: Ijaraga beriladi (o'zingiz e'lon yozing)

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 3 - Look at the two houses and write an advertisement for each one.
exercises.instructionUz: 3-UNIT — Ikkita uyga qarang va har biri uchun ijara e'loni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh VARAG'I.

  Ikkita uy surati va ikkita BO'Sh
  yozuv maydoni bor.

  ⚠ Kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN — vazifa
  suratlardagi YORLIQLARdan tushuniladi.


BETDAGI YORLIQLAR:

  'FOR RENT'  (ikkala uyda ham)
     = IJARAGA BERILADI

  'BARGAIN!'  (pastki uyda)
     = ARZON NARX! / QULAY TAKLIF!

  → Demak siz IJARA E'LONI yozasiz.


IKKI UY - IKKI XIL:

  1-UY (yuqorida):
     oq YOG'OCh uy, ikki qavatli,
     uchburchak tom, oq panjarali hovli,
     panjaraga suyalgan velosiped
     → a DETACHED HOUSE (alohida uy)

  2-UY (pastda):
     qizil G'IShTLI ko'p qavatli bino,
     temir panjarali balkonlar, pechak
     o'simligi, qora eshik
     → a BLOCK OF FLATS (kvartiralar
        binosi)

  ⚠ Bu farq MUHIM: 1-uyda BUTUN uy
  ijaraga beriladi, 2-uyda esa bitta
  KVARTIRA.


IJARA E'LONI QOLIPI:

──────────────────────────────────
  FOR RENT

  A beautiful house in the city
  centre.

  It's got three bedrooms, a large
  kitchen, two bathrooms and a
  living-room with a fireplace.

  There is a small garden with a
  white fence in front of the house.

  The rent is $800 a month.

  Phone: 555-2345
──────────────────────────────────


2-UY UChUN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  BARGAIN!  FOR RENT

  A lovely flat on the third floor
  of a red brick building.

  It's got two bedrooms, a kitchen,
  a bathroom and a living-room with
  a big balcony.

  There are a lot of trees in the
  street.

  The rent is only $450 a month -
  a real bargain!

  Phone: 555-7788
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ E'LONDA NIMA BO'LISHI KERAK:

  1) UY TURI  — house / flat
  2) JOYI     — in the city centre /
                near the park
  3) XONALAR  — It's got ... / There is ...
  4) AFZALLIK — a garden, a balcony,
                a fireplace, a great view
  5) NARX     — The rent is ... a month.
  6) ALOQA    — Phone: ...


⚠ 'RENT' - FE'L HAM, OT HAM:

  FE'L:  'to rent a flat'
         = kvartira ijaraga olmoq

  OT:    'The rent is $500 a month.'
         = Ijara haqi oyiga 500 dollar.

  ⚠ 'FOR RENT' = ijaraga beriladi
     'FOR SALE' = sotiladi


⚠ 'BARGAIN' NIMA:

  'a bargain' = arzon, foydali xarid

  'It's a real bargain!'
     = Bu haqiqatan ham arzon!

  ⚠ 'to bargain' (fe'l) = savdolashmoq

  Word List 120-betda Unit 3 bo'limida bor.


⚠ 'A MONTH' - 'IN A MONTH' EMAS:

  'The rent is $500 A MONTH.'
     = oyiga 500 dollar (HAR OY)

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'a' = 'har', 'per' ma'nosida:
     twice A day    = kuniga ikki marta
     $50 A week     = haftasiga 50 dollar
     60 km AN hour  = soatiga 60 km


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  for rent    = ijaraga beriladi
  for sale    = sotiladi
  the rent    = ijara haqi
  to rent     = ijaraga olmoq/bermoq
  a bargain   = arzon xarid
  a fence     = panjara
  a brick     = g'isht
  a detached house = alohida turgan uy
  a garden    = bog', hovli
  an advertisement (an ad) = e'lon

points.noteUz:
Ikkala uyda ham shu yorliq bor.

⚠ 'FOR RENT' = ijaraga beriladi;
'FOR SALE' = sotiladi.

Britaniyada ko'proq 'TO LET' deyiladi.

Faqat PASTKI uyda — sariq-qizil yulduzcha
ichida.

'a bargain' = arzon, foydali xarid.
'It's a real bargain!' = haqiqatan arzon!

⚠ 'to bargain' (fe'l) = savdolashmoq.

points.en: The first house is a detached house with a white fence and a garden.
points.uz: Birinchi uy — oq panjarali va hovlili alohida uy.
points.noteUz:
Oq YOG'OCH uy, ikki qavatli, uchburchak
tom, panjaraga suyalgan velosiped.

⚠ Bu yerda BUTUN uy ijaraga beriladi.

points.en: The second one is a flat in a red brick block of flats.
points.noteUz:
Temir panjarali balkonlar, pechak
o'simligi, qora eshik.

⚠ Bu yerda butun bino emas, bitta
KVARTIRA ijaraga beriladi.

⚠ 'A month' = HAR OY.

Bu yerda 'a' = 'har', 'per':
  twice a day = kuniga ikki marta
  $50 a week = haftasiga 50 dollar.

points.en: It's got three bedrooms. There is a small garden in front of the house.
points.uz: Unda uchta yotoqxona bor. Uy oldida kichik hovli bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'HAVE GOT' — egalik (uyning nimasi bor);
'THERE IS/ARE' — mavjudlik (qayerda nima bor).

Photo File 3-unit varag'idagi Paulaning xatida ham shu ikki
qolip ishlatilgan.

patterns.exampleEn: A beautiful house in the city centre.
patterns.explanationUz:
E'lon boshlanishi — fe'lsiz, qisqa.
⚠ E'lonlarda 'It is' tushirib qoldiriladi.

patterns.exampleEn: It's got three bedrooms, a large kitchen and two bathrooms.
patterns.exampleUz: Unda uchta yotoqxona, katta oshxona va ikkita hammom bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Xonalarni sanash — Photo File 3-unit varag'idagi Paulaning
xatidagi bilan bir xil qolip.

patterns.exampleEn: The rent is only $450 a month - a real bargain!
patterns.exampleUz: Ijara haqi atigi oyiga 450 dollar — haqiqatan arzon!
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a month' = har oy.
'only' so'zi narxni arzon ko'rsatadi.

patterns.formula: There is / There are ... in front of / near [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: There is a small garden with a white fence in front of the house.
patterns.exampleUz: Uy oldida oq panjarali kichik hovli bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'in front of' = oldida
(⚠ 'before' EMAS — 'before' vaqt uchun).
